candidate_premise: Restrict initial plume to histories generated by the same candidate source; ask whether this alone removes the preserved initial-field ambiguity when source rate may vary
scope: Three-cell deterministic algebra using existing core, not a new House/source-data world or seed run
construction: delta=q_future/(u+D). Start both fields at zero one step before observation. A at cell0 emits rate delta/dt on that pre-step; B at cell1 emits zero. Afterward both sources emit q_future. Do not assign the initial fields directly.
measurement: Alternate cells1/2 along the same mathematical observation path; apply the actual common FOPDT with reset sensor state0, which is separate from the plume prehistory
prediction: Source-consistent initial states remain separated by delta*e0 through future evolution, invisible at cells1/2. Later measuring cell0 in a positive-control unit trace reveals the difference.
critical_limit: A conditional nuisance-history witness is not equality of full distributions under a specified common stochastic release prior. This only rejects uniform identification over unrestricted nonnegative release histories.
next_decision: If verified, reachable same-source history alone cannot be the missing identifying contribution; require a justified statistical release law or observational separation, not zero-state omission or Bayes renaming.
